profile.headline: QA Software Engineer III at MedImpact Healthcare Systems, Inc.
profile.summary:
Highly motivated test engineer with extensive experience with a wide range of testing methodologies, test case and content creation within the pharmacy benefits management, wireless, and software development industries. Named by previous manager as number one tester for speed and accuracy. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, multi-tasking, and prioritization skills. Thrive in an AGILE environment.

Key skills include:
Testing skills:
Web services (SOAP/REST) testing and troubleshooting, developing test scenarios, acceptance tests for wireless operators, performance tests, logging/tracing, white box/black box testing, 

Technologies:
ReadyAPI, web services, SQL, Oracle, LINUX, Windows Phone 7/8/10, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, CDMA, 3G, LTE, GSM, GPRS, Qualcomm phone diagnostic tools, Windows Phone kits, XML, some JAVA familiarity

positions.title: QA Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Converted from contractor to fulltime MedImpact employee; job duties are the same as position listed below, plus:
-Configuring, testing, and troubleshooting web services (REST and SOAP)
-Adding new test cases to automation framework via TestNG

positions.title: SQA Engineer
positions.description:
•	Writing test scenarios to test Point Of Sale component of pharmacy benefits management system
•	Running test scripts, analyzing results, and comparing results to previous release
•	Investigating and reporting defects
•	Creating SQL queries to query Oracle database

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test
positions.description:
•	Performed manual testing on Microsoft Windows smartphones and tablets for AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile, and Sprint using the carriers’ acceptance test plans, contributing to the successful launch of numerous products
•	Performed a wide variety of functional, feature interaction, and performance tests
•	Investigated errors, collected logs, and created error reports
•	Performed detailed Bluetooth profile testing on Windows Phones using a variety of specified Bluetooth accessories

positions.title: Senior Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
•	All duties described in "Software Development Test Engineer, Microsoft" above, plus:
•	Test lead for several successful projects, including J2ME (Java 2 Mobile Edition), multimedia, and in-app payment features on Nokia mobile phones
•	Created and maintained test plans, test specifications, and use cases
•	Compiled and configured software builds for testing and test content development purposes using CM Synergy configuration management tool
•	Created Java MIDlets to test a variety of J2ME functionalities
•	Worked closely with developers to perform analysis, troubleshooting, and debugging
•	Test lead for Nokia’s implementation of the OEM layer of Qualcomm’s BREW (Binary Runtime Environment for Wireless) on Nokia mobile phones
•	Modified and added functionality to the framework of third-party automated test tool for BREW using Perl and XML, greatly increasing the flexibility of the tool.
•	Interviewed BREW test candidates; mentored and trained junior testers
•	Gave extensive support to other groups testing BREW, greatly increasing other teams’ knowledge and helped decrease false errors filed against the program

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
•	Performed manual and automated tests on the OEM layer of Qualcomm’s BREW (Binary Runtime Environment for Wireless) on Nokia mobile phones
•	Created test plans and test cases 
•	Interviewed BREW test candidates; mentored and trained junior testers

positions.title: Quality Assurance Tester/Analyst/Test Project Lead
positions.description:
Project Lead	2002-2003
•	Test lead for wireless enterprise software on a variety of platforms and mobile devices as well as web-based and desktop versions
•	Maintained test environment, including installing software onto Windows and Lotus Domino servers and troubleshooting servers
•	Wrote and maintained test plans and outlines
Queried and edited SQL databases
•	All duties listed below in QA Analyst and QA Tester positions
	
QA Analyst	2002-2002
•	Wrote automated test cases using XML
•	Created test cases and scripts
•	All duties listed below in QA Tester position

QA Tester	2000-2002
•	Performed manual testing of core enterprise and custom applications on a wide variety of wireless devices and platforms. Testing included smoke test, sanity, build verification, full feature, regression, and TRUE BREW testing. My testing efforts led to our first custom BREW application, Zagat To Go, successfully passing Qualcomm’s TRUE BREW certification process
•	Performed troubleshooting on all components and produced error reports
•	Installed the software onto handheld devices
•	Reviewed technical documentation

positions.title: QA Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
•	Performed regression, installation, and verification tests for an accounting software product in client/server, web, and IVR (interactive voice response) environments
•	Created test cases. Greatly increased the range of test coverage for all components of the software
•	Installed and configured the client/server software onto UNIX and Windows NT platforms
•	Installed Oracle 8; created and configured Oracle databases
•	Investigated errors and entered defects into Connect Care defect database

company.name: Maxwell Business Systems, contracted by QSI

volunteerExperiences.description:
•	Managing financial aid cases 
•	Purchasing medical supplies for pets with chronic medical needs
•	Helping Board of Directors define policies and procedures
•	Posting fundraising information for pets in our financial aid program

patents.title: Method and apparatus for searching external issues for testing a product
patents.description: Methods and apparatus for performing a test on a product include applying a test on a product and, if the test indicates a defect in the product, determining whether the defect is external to the product. The method further includes, if the defect is determined to be external to the product, skipping repair of the product for the defect. In one aspect, a method for performing a test on a product includes determining an external defect for the product and, if an external defect exists for the product, skipping further testing of the product for the determined external defect.
